2026-10-08 03:55:58.350972 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-10-08 03:55:58.350977 | controller |
2026-10-08 03:55:58.350982 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-08 03:55:58.350987 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-08 03:55:58.351008 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-08 03:55:58.351013 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-08 03:55:58.351018 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-08 03:55:58.351031 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
